hook: Apne hi [[department]] se zyada kaun kamata hai?

slides.title: Normal vs [[correlated]]
points: Correlated: **outer row ka column** use karti
Isliye **har row ke liye** dobara chalti hai
slides.note: Har employee ke liye alag sawaal: "**tere** dept ka average kya?"

slides.title: Dept avg se [[zyada]]
slides.code:
SELECT name, dept, salary
FROM employees e
WHERE salary > (
  SELECT AVG(salary)
  FROM employees
  WHERE dept = e.dept
);
slides.note: **e.dept** = bahar wali row ka dept. Yahi "correlation" hai 🔗

slides.title: Andar kya [[chalta]] hai
points: Row 1: Aarav, IT → IT ka avg nikalo
Row 2: Kabir, IT → **phir se** IT avg
slides.note: Modern optimizer kai baar khud rewrite kar deta hai, par bharosa mat karo

slides.title: Window se [[fast]] version
slides.code:
WITH x AS (
  SELECT name, salary,
    AVG(salary) OVER (
      PARTITION BY dept) AS a
  FROM employees
)
SELECT * FROM x
WHERE salary > a;
slides.note: Table **ek hi baar** scan, result same 🚀

slides.wrong:
SELECT AVG(salary)
FROM employees
WHERE dept = dept
slides.right:
SELECT AVG(salary)
FROM employees
WHERE dept = **e.dept**
slides.why: dept = dept hamesha **true** → poori company ka avg aa gaya, dept wala nahi 💀
